# Data Source: identitynow_custom_user_level

Use this data source to look up a custom user level by ID.

~> **Note:** This data source uses an experimental API that may change without notice.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_custom_user_level" "identity_managers" {
  id = "beb02a57-010f-4c29-a6d2-fae9628bda73"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) User level ID.

### Read-Only

- `associated_identities_count` (Number) Number of identities the user level is assigned to.
- `created` (String) Creation date.
- `description` (String) Description of the user level.
- `modified` (String) Last modification date.
- `name` (String) Name of the user level.
- `owner` (Attributes List) Identity that owns the user level. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))
- `right_sets` (Set of String) IDs of the right sets assigned to the user level.
- `status` (String) Status of the user level, `DRAFT` or `ACTIVE`.

<a id="nestedatt--owner"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owner`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Owner identity ID.
- `name` (String) Owner display name.
- `type` (String) Owner type.
